description: This file defines a mutable builder class for constructing an immutable set of features (`ImmutableFeatures`) with a fluent API. The class provides methods to add, retrieve, remove, and clear features, and to build the final immutable features object.

classes.name: ImmutableFeaturesBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, fluent builder class for constructing immutable features collections.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder with an empty features map.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds a feature to the builder; replaces any existing feature with the same ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a feature by its ID, returning an Optional.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds all features from an iterable collection to the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific feature from the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a feature by its ID.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Clears all features from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable features object.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the features in the builder.
